video_title: Josh Hart on the massive win in Atlanta

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on opponent's high turnovers in a dominant win
quotes.quote: You're so locked in mentally that whole day on, 'this is going to be a tough game, it's going to be a wire-to-wire game, we got to battle, value every possession, whatever.' And then you look up and you're up 60. We got obviously respect for them, but we were scoring basically whenever we wanted. At halftime, they had more turnovers than field goals.
